business_problem: The team relied on a wide range of models from different providers to power these demanding workloads, but that resulted in several operational and financial bottlenecks. Because the company was tied to standard API pricing with limited options for cost control, compute expenses ballooned.
solution_summary: Some of these providers were also inconsistent with unexplained timeouts and restrictive usage limits that disrupted their development pipelines. When an API limit was unexpectedly reached, processes would halt and waste tokens. This meant the team had to restart some complex experiments from scratch. "We felt so limited in our ability to control costs," says Mehul Revankar, Co-founder and CPO at Quantro Security. "We started to explore our options and realized we didn't have to move our entire workload to one platform. We could just shift some of it to test, and that opened up so many new possibilities." Through Model Garden on Gemini Enterprise, the team gained the flexibility to experiment with a wide variety of open-source models outside of their previous closed ecosystem.
